entries.instruction: Use each arm to grab the medium bottle for liquids and the hand-sized yellow plastic bottle.
Use each arm to lift a bottle: the yellow bottle with white cap, then the bottle with yellow Chinese characters.
Grab the liquid container dark brown plastic with one arm, grab the bottle with white and yellow label with the other.
Use each arm to grab the medium plastic bottle and the brown bottle.
Pick up both the brown bottle and the glossy brown bottle together.
Grab the medium plastic bottle with one arm, grab the gray bottle for holding drinks with the other.
Grab the bottle with yellow Chinese characters and the yellow rectangular bottle at the same time.
Grab the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom and the smooth bottle with blue text at the same time.
Pick up the bottle with red screw cap with one arm, grab the glossy brown bottle with the other.
Use each arm to lift a bottle: the bottle with attached loop on cap, then the lightweight plastic brown bottle.
Grab the plastic orange bottle with rounded base and the bottle with ridged neck at the same time.
Use each arm to grab the medium bottle for liquids and the bottle with ridges near base.
Pick up the bottle with green base and black prints and take the green bottle with white label together.
Grab the white capped orange plastic bottle with one arm, grab the blue-capped plastic bottle with the other.
Use each arm to grab the plastic soda bottle and the medium bottle.
Lift the medium plastic bottle using one arm and lift the plastic orange bottle with rounded base using the other.
Lift the bottle with ridged orange grip using one arm and lift the medium bottle using the other.
Grab the cylindrical plastic bottle for carrying water and grab the bottle with white and yellow label at once.
Grab the medium-sized drink bottle and grab the bottle with curved neck design at once.
Grab the hand-sized bottle with ridged bottom with one arm, grab the brown bottle with the other.
